wildcat.caption:
NASA's Mars Perseverance rover acquired this image using its Left Mastcam-Z camera. Mastcam-Z is a pair of cameras located high on the rover's mast.

This image was acquired on July 19, 2022 (Sol 502)

skinner.caption: NASA's Mars Perseverance rover acquired this image using its Left Mastcam-Z camera. This image was acquired on June 23, 2022 (Sol 477).

rocknest.caption: Curiosity Mastcam left frame, sol 59. Wheel and crusty/rocky surface at the Rocknest sand patch area. Same sol as the station's waypoint record.

shaler.caption: Curiosity Mastcam left frame, sol 120. Layered outcrop imaged from the rover's recorded sol-120 position (the Shaler viewpoint record).

drillsites.caption: Curiosity Mastcam left frame, sol 182. Veined, drilled mudstone at the John Klein / Cumberland parking (MSL site 6, waypoint records sols 166-317).

departure.caption: Curiosity Mastcam left frame, sol 324. Rocky terrain at the start of the Mount Sharp trek; same sol as the departure waypoint record.
